dimensions.evidenceB: Taking away sins is denied to animal blood.

dimensions.evidenceA: Cases repeat for priest, assembly, ruler, and common person.
dimensions.evidenceB: Yearly repetition is contrasted with one offering.

evidence.observation: The priest makes atonement with the sin offering, and the person or assembly is forgiven.
The letter says the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins.

record.tension: Leviticus states that the priest makes atonement and forgiveness follows, while Hebrews says animal blood cannot take away sins.
record.title: What do animal offerings do about sin?
